sliders.name: temp
sliders.label: Color Temperature (K)
sliders.cmd: busctl --user set-property rs.wl-gammarelay / rs.wl.gammarelay Temperature q ${VAL}

sliders.name: brightness_gamma
sliders.label: Brightness
sliders.cmd: busctl --user set-property rs.wl-gammarelay / rs.wl.gammarelay Brightness d ${VAL}

sliders.name: gamma
sliders.label: Gamma
sliders.cmd: busctl --user set-property rs.wl-gammarelay / rs.wl.gammarelay Gamma d ${VAL}
